question: Should OpenClaw accept comparative Usage cost windows and daily chart scale labels in the Control UI after this branch is rebased cleanly?
rationale: The implementation shape is bounded and proof-backed, but this is a new operator-facing dashboard presentation linked to a protected maintainer-labeled product issue, and the current branch cannot merge cleanly.

options.title: Accept After Rebase
options.body: Approve the feature once the branch is mergeable and exact-head Usage, gateway, i18n, docs, and changed checks are fresh.

options.title: Request Product Adjustments
options.body: Keep the PR open but ask for specific changes to card placement, wording, window rules, or visual treatment before acceptance.

options.title: Defer The Feature
options.body: Pause or close the PR if maintainers do not want comparative cost analysis in the core Usage dashboard right now.

recommendation.title: Accept After Rebase
recommendation.body: Approve the feature once the branch is mergeable and exact-head Usage, gateway, i18n, docs, and changed checks are fresh.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the linked proposal and PR branch and has recent adjacent cost-UI history.
